assembly_notes: Five component slots form 300 complete structural combinations; the palette_count multiplicity raises the raw domain to 1800. The chassis is always one rooted case_body with a real deck recess whose rim the lid box closes onto; the lid is always a rear-hinged mirrored box registered from an AxisInterface mate. Stations cycle the left/right/front walls and each owns its own derived vertical level, so the chassis height, plinth, cavities, runners, bearing bridges, posts and knuckle lugs all grow with N and with the tray dimensions. Prismatic trays are seated with mate_planes on their real runner footprint; every rotational joint is solved with mate_axes and registered with register_interface_mate. All palette motion stays below the case rim in Z or outboard of the case plan, so a closed lid never shares space with a deployed tray. No overlap allowance is used anywhere.
